title: Machine codec case
statement: For a finite Turing machine $M$ with Boolean alphabet, a codec case consists of an optional state of $M$, an optional Boolean input symbol, and, for each work tape of $M$, an optional Boolean symbol.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine with Boolean alphabet
